build.buildCommand:
cd /Users/adam/Developer/vcs3/github.vexyart/vexy-hrefc-js
echo "=== build + test (src has my centering change) ==="
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E 'global.min'
node --test 2>&1 | grep -E 'tests [0-9]+|pass [0-9]+|fail [0-9]+' | tail -3
echo
echo "=== new terms present in docs/README? ==="
for term in 'cta' 'arrow' 'hrefc-card' 'hrefc-cta' 'centered\|centred\|above the link\|over the link'; do
  echo "  '$term': $(grep -rilE "$term" README.md CHANGELOG.md docs/*.md 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ')"
done
echo
echo "=== configuration.md: cta + arrow + placement rows ==="
grep -nE '`?cta`?|`?arrow`?|placement' docs/configuration.md | grep -iE 'cta|arrow|above|center|placement' | head -8
echo
echo "=== bare URLs sneaking into edited md? (lint) ==="
grep -rnE 'https?://' README.md docs/configuration.md docs/styling.md docs/getting-started.md docs/index.md 2>/dev/null | grep -vE '<https?://|\(https?://|cdn\.jsdelivr|```|    ' | head
